verification_notes.note: Removed due to substantial overlap with D2. Both units evaluate the same ransomware attack event and its DKK 2.5m cost impact; D2 sufficiently covers the material financial impact on EBITDA, while D8 provides redundant event details (timing, infrastructure rebuilding) that are secondary descriptors per CORE-CONTENT RULE. Core fact of attack and cost is already captured in D2.

redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. No pairs substantially overlap: each unit addresses distinct core content (revenue, EBITDA, profit, cash flow, outlook, market dynamics, regional outlook, liquidity, strategy). D2 and D8 were merged via removal of D8 to resolve overlap.

key_information_units.information: Revenue decreased by 8% to DKK 269m in 2025 from DKK 294m in 2024, primarily due to a slow start to the year and reduced sales to a Nordic key customer.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 11: 'Revenue amounted to DKK 269m in 2025 (2024: DKK 294m) equivalent to a decrease of 8% primarily explained by a slow start of 2025 and less sale to a key customer (Nordic)'

key_information_units.information: EBITDA declined to DKK 28m (10.4% margin) from DKK 37m (12.7% margin) in 2024, driven by maintained higher fixed costs to support future growth and DKK 2.5m one-off costs from a ransomware attack.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 11: 'Operating profit (EBITDA) amounted to DKK 28.0m in 2025 (2024: DKK 37.3m) equivalent to an EBITDA margin of 10.4% (2024: 12.7%). While Gross Profit margin increased in 2025 the EBITDA margin decreased linked to maintained fixed cost levels – to support future growth. Fixed cost was affected negatively with oneoff costs of DKK 2.5m linked to a ransomware attack in May-June.'

key_information_units.information: Profit after tax fell to DKK 0.9m from DKK 10.6m in 2024, adversely impacted by non-utilisation of tax assets resulting in a higher effective tax rate.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 11: 'Profit after tax amounted to DKK 0.9m in 2025 (2024: DKK 10.6m). The high tax on profit comes from not utilization of tax assets (tax loss carryforward).' Note 9 shows effective tax rate of 70% (2025) vs 13% (2024).

key_information_units.information: Cash flow from operating activities remained strong at DKK 28.5m (2024: DKK 29.4m), with improvements in net working capital offsetting lower revenue.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 12: 'Cash flow from operating activities amounted to DKK 28.5m (2024: DKK 29.4m). The decrease is primarily attributable to the decrease in activity/revenue however it has been possible to improve the net working capital – mainly on inventories and Work in Progress.'

key_information_units.information: 2026 outlook targets organic revenue growth of 7-14% to DKK 290-310m and EBITDA of DKK 45-55m (8-10% margin), reflecting continued focus on profitability.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 12: 'In 2026, revenue is expected to grow organically in range from 7% to 14% to DKK 290-310m, while EBITDA is expected to increase to DKK 45-55m, equivalent to an EBITDA-margin of around 8-10%.'

key_information_units.information: Market activity improved in H2 2025 as interest rates stabilized, boosting non-residential project execution, while residential demand remained subdued due to low consumer confidence.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 10: 'As interest rates stabilized during 2025, market activity improved, particularly in the second half of the year. Within the non-residential segment, project execution accelerated... demand in the residential market remained more subdued, reflecting continued low consumer confidence.'

key_information_units.information: North America market remains attractive for green technology despite import tariff uncertainties; WindowMaster's local presence and unique niche position mitigate competitive pressures.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 10: 'In North America, the market for green technology remains attractive... The big uncertainty due to import toll has not altered the Company’s outlook for the region... we are currently the only manufacturer of window automation within the intelligent natural ventilation niche with a local presence in the United States.'

key_information_units.information: Liquidity position shows net interest-bearing debt of DKK 38.7m (up from DKK 36.7m in 2024) and equity ratio at 23.5% (below target of >25%), with strong banking relationships maintaining capital access.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 12: 'Net interest-bearing debt at the end of 2025 amounted to DKK 38.7m (End of 2024: DKK 36.7m)... At the end of 2025, equity amounted to DKK 32.5m... equivalent to an equity ratio of 23.5% (net cash). The target is to be above 25%.'

key_information_units.information: Strategic initiative 'Accelerate Core' focuses on scaling production, streamlining products, and leveraging natural, mixed-mode, and heat/smoke ventilation solutions to drive growth and profitability.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management's Review page 9: 'In 2024, WindowMaster adopted a new strategy “Accelerate Core”... The Company has established a scalable production platform in Herford (Germany), a streamlined and focused product offering... Our business strategy will lift growth and profitability by accelerating our core business and by focusing on three strategic offerings based on our natural, mixed mode, and heat and smoke ventilation solutions.'
